tripDetectionAssumption.trafficLightRule: If engine remains on, stationary periods remain within the same trip.
tripDetectionAssumption.importantLimitation: Engine state is simulated. Real engine status requires a compatible vehicle tracker or vehicle interface.

routeGeometry.notes: Waypoints follow the general A3 Colombo-Negombo Road corridor between Ja-Ela, Kandana, Mahabage, Wattala, Peliyagoda and Colombo, plus illustrative local loops. Intermediate 5-second points are interpolated between waypoints and are NOT verified road-snapped GPS traces. Inspect on MapKit and replace with actual OSM/router geometry before presenting as exact road paths.
